name: Cleanup.pictures
short_description: AI inpainting tool that removes unwanted objects, people or text from a photo in the browser.
short_description_fr: Outil d’inpainting IA qui retire objets, personnes ou texte indésirables d’une photo, dans le navigateur.
features: AI object removal / inpainting in the browser, on desktop and mobile; Free plan: unlimited images limited to 720p, plus an HD-quality trial; Pro: unlimited resolution and a high-quality refiner; ClipDrop Pro bundle advertised on the same page is a separate product, not listed here

name: Palette.fm
short_description: AI colorizer that turns black-and-white photos into realistic color with 21+ adjustable filters.
short_description_fr: Coloriseur IA qui transforme des photos noir et blanc en couleurs réalistes, avec plus de 21 filtres réglables.
features: More than 21 color filters, plus color adjustments and keyword-guided colorization; Free previews up to 500×500 with a watermark, and 1 trial credit for a full-resolution export; Yearly subscription (480 credits/year) or a one-time 75-credit pack, valid 2 years; Official site lists a Portugal address in the footer

name: Generated Photos
short_description: Library and generators of unique AI model photos — faces and full-body humans — for design, marketing and research, with commercial use on paid plans.
short_description_fr: Bibliothèque et générateurs de photos de mannequins IA uniques — visages et corps — pour le design, le marketing et la recherche, avec usage commercial sur les offres payantes.
features: Library of unique AI model photos — faces and full-body humans; Face Generator and Human Generator; Commercial use and no watermarks on paid plans; Yearly plans or official volume prices per photo; monthly list prices not extracted

name: Upscale.media
short_description: Browser AI image upscaler (a PixelBin product) that enlarges and enhances photos on a monthly credit allowance or one-time credit packs.
short_description_fr: Agrandisseur d’images IA dans le navigateur (produit PixelBin) qui améliore les photos via un forfait de crédits ou des packs à l’achat unique.
features: Browser AI image upscaler, a PixelBin product, with face enhancements; Free plan: 3 credits and 3 downloads every month; Yearly subscription billed at 63.53 €, or one-time credit packs valid 1 year; API integration mentioned; Enterprise is talk-to-sales

name: Kickresume
short_description: AI resume and cover-letter builder with recruiter-designed templates, an ATS checker and a career map, used by millions of job seekers.
short_description_fr: Créateur IA de CV et de lettres de motivation, avec des modèles conçus par des recruteurs, un contrôle ATS et une carte de carrière, utilisé par des millions de candidats.
features: AI Writer that can generate a resume from a job title and job ad; 40+ recruiter-designed premium templates, ATS Resume Checker and Career Map; LinkedIn and PDF import, iOS and Android apps, personal website templates; Free plan with unlimited downloads; Premium monthly, quarterly or yearly, already priced in euro

name: Rezi
short_description: AI resume builder that writes, scores and keyword-targets a CV for applicant tracking systems, with cover letters and interview practice.
short_description_fr: Créateur de CV IA qui rédige, note et cible les mots-clés d’un CV pour les ATS, avec lettres de motivation et entraînement à l’entretien.
features: AI Resume Writer and Editor, Rezi Score and keyword targeting for ATS; Cover letter builder and AI interview practice; PDF export, on Free, Pro, Lifetime or Enterprise; Not Prezi — this is rezi.ai, a resume tool

name: Huntr
short_description: AI job-search workspace that builds tailored resumes and cover letters, tracks applications and matches your profile to roles.
short_description_fr: Espace de recherche d’emploi IA qui crée des CV et des lettres adaptés à chaque offre, suit les candidatures et rapproche ton profil des postes.
features: Resume and cover-letter builder, with job-tailored versions on paid plans; Job tracker, Chrome Job Clipper, map view and application autofill; Resume scoring and job matching, basic on Free, advanced on Pro; Free plan is always free, with no hidden costs

name: Teal
short_description: AI career platform with a resume builder, job tracker, keyword matching and cover-letter tools to run a job search in one place.
short_description_fr: Plateforme de carrière IA avec créateur de CV, suivi des candidatures, correspondance de mots-clés et outils de lettres de motivation pour piloter une recherche d’emploi.
features: AI resume builder, job tracker and keyword matching with a match score; Resume bullet and summary generators, email templates and resume templates; Free Forever plan with listed limits, no card required to start; Teal+ billed weekly, every 30 days or every 90 days

name: Jobscan
short_description: Resume scanner that checks a CV against a job description for ATS and recruiter keywords, with AI cover-letter and bullet tools on paid plans.
short_description_fr: Scanner de CV qui compare un curriculum à une offre pour les mots-clés ATS et recruteurs, avec outils IA de lettre et de puces sur les offres payantes.
features: Resume scans against a job description, with ATS and recruiter findings; Job tracker, resume builder and manager, Chrome extension and Learning Center on Free; AI optimizations, cover-letter and bullet generators, LinkedIn optimizer and interview practice on paid plans (some features desktop only, or after the trial); Quarterly plan includes a 7-day trial; official FAQ: no trial if you pick monthly

name: Resume.io
short_description: Online resume builder with an AI resume helper, field-tested templates and cover-letter tools to create and download a job-ready CV.
short_description_fr: Créateur de CV en ligne avec assistance IA, modèles éprouvés et outils de lettres de motivation pour rédiger et télécharger un CV prêt à postuler.
features: AI resume helper, field-tested templates and cover-letter tools; Free plan limited to one resume and one cover letter; Paid path: 7-day trial at 2.95 € (promo, not the normal price), then 24.95 € every 4 weeks, or 49.95 € every 3 months; Official 7-day money-back guarantee

name: Eduaide
short_description: AI toolkit for teachers that generates lessons, questions, rubrics, supports and classroom images, with a document-chat assistant on Pro.
short_description_fr: Boîte à outils IA pour enseignants qui génère cours, questions, rubriques, aides et images de classe, avec un assistant de discussion sur documents en Pro.
features: Resource generation for core classroom workflows: lessons, questions, rubrics and supports; Free plan: up to 8 resources a month (24 credits), no credit card; Pro adds Erasmus document chat, classroom images, YouTube transcripts and a reasoning model; First Pro payment can be refunded in full within 14 days; renewals are not refundable

name: Explainpaper
short_description: Research reader that highlights a paper and explains the passage, with follow-up questions and, on Pro, figure explanations and outlines.
short_description_fr: Lecteur de recherche qui surligne un article et en explique le passage, avec questions de suivi et, en Pro, explications de figures et plans automatiques.
features: Highlight a paper and get an explanation of the passage, with follow-up questions; Free forever: unlimited highlight explanations, Zotero import, basic AI models; Pro (7-day trial): figure and equation explanations, automatic outlines, saved highlights; Teams is contact-us, with volume discounts

name: Anara
short_description: AI research workspace (the official rebrand of Unriddle) for uploading papers, chatting with sources, and collaborating on literature work.
short_description_fr: Espace de recherche IA (nouveau nom officiel d’Unriddle) pour déposer des articles, discuter avec les sources et collaborer sur une revue de littérature.
features: Official rebrand of Unriddle: chat and editing over uploaded papers; Free: Zotero and Mendeley connectors, limited usage, no card; Plus adds science databases (including PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov); Pro adds OCR, model choice and cloud connectors; Max adds Deep Search and Model Council; Prices per seat are taken from the official FAQ (Plus / Pro / Max 5x / Max 20x)

name: Shortly AI
short_description: Writing and chat workspace that puts 100+ AI models in one subscription, with web search, file chat and image generation.
short_description_fr: Espace d’écriture et de chat qui réunit plus de 100 modèles IA dans un seul abonnement, avec recherche web, discussion sur fichiers et génération d’images.
features: One workspace for 100+ AI models, with web search and image generation; AI writing assistant: draft, rewrite, refine and creative writing; Chat with images and documents; Plus or Pro billed monthly; yearly totals not extracted, so not listed. Labelled Premium

name: TextCortex
short_description: AI writing and knowledge-base workspace where teams build custom agents, connect sources and automate everyday text workflows.
short_description_fr: Espace d’écriture et de base de connaissances IA où les équipes créent des agents, connectent leurs sources et automatisent les flux de texte du quotidien.
features: Knowledge bases, custom agents, agent skills and connectors; Access to major models and workflow automations, with up to 10 GB storage on Premium; Premium billed per user, monthly or annually, excl. VAT; No lasting Free plan on the official pricing page — labelled Premium

name: Linguix
short_description: AI writing and grammar assistant that checks spelling, rewrites sentences and works in a browser extension wherever you type.
short_description_fr: Assistant d’écriture et de grammaire IA qui corrige l’orthographe, réécrit les phrases et s’intègre via une extension là où tu tapes.
features: Grammar and spelling checks, AI suggestions and paraphrasing; Typing shortcuts and a browser extension that works where you type; Free forever for basic checks; Pro is billed annually at the official 11 €/month / 127 € year figure; Style, clarity and tone tools on Pro; Business is linked separately and not listed here

name: AskYourPDF
short_description: AI chatbot for PDFs and websites: train an agent on your documents, chat with them, and embed answers for visitors.
short_description_fr: Chatbot IA pour PDF et sites web : entraîne un agent sur tes documents, discute avec eux et intègre les réponses pour tes visiteurs.
features: Train an AI agent on documents or websites and chat with them; Visitor conversations you can embed, plus a Chrome extension and OCR on paid plans; Free: up to 5 documents, 50 questions a day, GPT-5 Mini; Premium or Pro, monthly or yearly; Enterprise is custom

name: Teachmate
short_description: UK-oriented suite of 160 AI tools for teachers: slideshows, worksheets, open chat, a secure report writer and a “clone my tone” feature.
short_description_fr: Suite d’environ 160 outils IA pour enseignants, orientée Royaume-Uni : diaporamas, fiches, chat, rédacteur de bulletins sécurisé et fonction « clone my tone ».
features: UK-oriented suite of 160 AI tools for teachers: slideshows, worksheets, Open Chat, Secure Report Writer and Clone my Tone; Free plan is “free tools only”, not the full library; Pro monthly or annual; FIRSTYEAR is a first-year promo, normal annual is the regular 86 € rate; Whole School plans from 2 € per teacher per month, with SSO, DPIA support and invoice payment

name: Brain.fm
short_description: Functional music service designed to help you focus, relax or sleep, with an optional free trial before a monthly or yearly plan.
short_description_fr: Service de musique fonctionnelle conçu pour t’aider à te concentrer, te détendre ou dormir, avec un essai gratuit optionnel avant un forfait mensuel ou annuel.
features: Functional music designed to help you focus, relax or sleep; Science-backed positioning on the official site; Monthly or yearly plan, with an official “Try for Free” trial; Labelled Premium: the trial is not a lasting free plan

name: Audo
short_description: Browser audio toolkit that enhances, cleans, transcribes and generates sound; every tool is free on the first part of a file, then pay-as-you-go credits.
short_description_fr: Boîte à outils audio dans le navigateur pour améliorer, nettoyer, transcrire et générer du son : chaque outil est gratuit sur le début d’un fichier, puis crédits à l’usage.
features: Browser audio toolkit: enhance, clean, transcribe and generate sound; Every tool is free on the first part of a file, with no sign-up; Pay-as-you-go credits that never expire, charged only when a job succeeds; The 5 € / 500-credit pack is first purchase only — labelled as a promo

name: Transkriptor
short_description: AI transcription service for meetings, audio and video in 100+ languages, with summaries, translation and a team workspace on higher plans.
short_description_fr: Service de transcription IA pour réunions, audio et vidéo dans plus de 100 langues, avec résumés, traduction et espace d’équipe sur les offres supérieures.
features: AI transcription of meetings, audio and video in 100+ languages; Edit, translate, share and download transcripts, on web and mobile; Pro adds AI summary, AI chat and a knowledge base; Team adds spaces, custom vocabulary and call analysis; Labelled Premium: “Try it Free” is offered, without a documented lasting 0 € minute allowance

name: JoggAI
short_description: AI video platform for avatar, product and image-to-video clips, with credits shared across the web app, API and MCP.
short_description_fr: Plateforme vidéo IA pour clips avatar, produit et image-vers-vidéo, avec des crédits partagés entre l’app web, l’API et le MCP.
features: AI video platform for avatar, product and image-to-video clips, plus voice clones; Credits are shared across the web app, API and MCP; Free 200 credits are promotional, valid 31 days, and do not renew monthly — not a recurring allowance; Starter monthly is in the official FAQ (26 €, 12,000 credits); yearly Starter, Creator and Team are on the pricing page. Other monthly list prices are not listed

name: 2short.ai
short_description: AI clipper that turns a long YouTube video into Shorts, TikToks and Reels by extracting the strongest spoken moments.
short_description_fr: Outil de découpage IA qui transforme une longue vidéo YouTube en Shorts, TikToks et Reels en extrayant les moments parlants les plus forts.
features: Turns a long YouTube video into Shorts, TikToks and Reels by extracting the strongest spoken moments; Facial tracking and export of short clips; Google Drive and public URLs on paid plans; Free: 30 minutes of AI analyzing per month; Lite, Pro or Premium for more hours and faster server-side exports

name: LogoAI
short_description: AI logo maker with a living brand kit, design studio and image/video generations, offered as a paid trial that renews into a Pro plan.
short_description_fr: Créateur de logos IA avec kit de marque, studio de design et générations image/vidéo, proposé via un essai payant qui se reconduit en offre Pro.
features: AI logo maker with a living brand kit, logo animations and brand videos; Design studio, batch image and video generations, 20+ AI models; Unrestricted downloads and commercial use on paid plans (does not guarantee exclusivity or trademark registration); Paid 7-day trial that renews into Pro — labelled Premium, not Freemium

name: Presentations.AI
short_description: AI presentation platform that generates slide decks, exports to PowerPoint and lets you track and brand the result.
short_description_fr: Plateforme de présentations IA qui génère des diaporamas, les exporte en PowerPoint et permet de les suivre et de les habiller à l’image de la marque.
features: AI models and agents for slide generation, with PowerPoint and PDF export on paid plans; Presentation tracking and analytics, plus brand customization; Starter at 0 € with 200 credits and a 20-slide cap; Pro and Gold are billed annually; monthly list prices were not extracted

name: Slidesgo
short_description: Library of designer-made PPT and Google Slides templates, with a free allowance of AI-generated presentations and a Premium plan for higher limits.
short_description_fr: Bibliothèque de modèles PPT et Google Slides conçus par des designers, avec un quota gratuit de présentations générées par IA et une offre Premium pour plus de volume.
features: 30,000+ designer-made PPT and Google Slides templates, plus an online editor; Free: 3 AI-generated presentations and 3 downloads per month; Premium is described as Unlimited, with an official security cap of 150 AI generations and 150 downloads per month; Teacher toolkits, Slidesclass lessons, team seats, ad-free and no attribution on Premium

name: Postwise
short_description: AI social-media workspace that writes posts, schedules them and analyses performance, with a 7-day trial on monthly plans.
short_description_fr: Espace de réseaux sociaux IA qui rédige des posts, les planifie et en analyse les performances, avec un essai de 7 jours sur les forfaits mensuels.
features: AI-generated posts, GhostWriter assistant, scheduling and custom AI voices; Analytics on Boss; custom AI training on Unlimited; Monthly plans with a 7-day free trial, then auto-subscribe, cancel anytime; Labelled Premium: the trial is not a lasting free plan

name: Finaloop
short_description: AI-native ecommerce accounting, inventory and analytics platform for consumer brands, with a public Starter rate for businesses up to 1 million in annual gross revenue.
short_description_fr: Plateforme de comptabilité, de stocks et d’analytique IA pour marques e-commerce, avec un tarif Starter public pour les entreprises jusqu’à 904 814 € de revenu brut annuel.
features: AI-native ecommerce accounting, inventory (COGS, landed cost) and analytics; Automated categorization, bank reconciliation and 3-way sales reconciliations; Real-time reports and dashboards, with official 48-hour onboarding; Only the public Starter rate is priced here; higher tiers are talk-to-an-expert

name: Puzzle
short_description: AI accounting software for startups that categorizes transactions, drafts statements and can also be paired with bookkeeping services.
short_description_fr: Logiciel de comptabilité IA pour startups qui catégorise les transactions, prépare les états financiers et peut être associé à un service de tenue de livres.
features: Automatic categorization of most transactions and auto-drafted cash and accrual statements; Unlimited connections; AI Suite (Chat, Cowork, Close) with plan-based AI credits; Insights on cash, burn, runway and margin from Core up; Yearly totals not itemized (“12 months for the price of 10”) — not invented. Labelled Premium

name: Finta
short_description: Finance data platform that syncs bank transactions into tools like Notion, Airtable and Google Sheets, with AI categorization plus API and MCP access.
short_description_fr: Plateforme de données financières qui synchronise les transactions bancaires vers Notion, Airtable ou Google Sheets, avec catégorisation IA plus accès API et MCP.
features: Bank connections that sync transactions into Notion, Airtable and Google Sheets; AI-powered categorization, plus MCP and a developer API; 7-day free trial, no card, then Standard or Business Pro billed annually; Monthly list prices besides the annually billed figures were not extracted — not invented. Labelled Premium
